verdict.rationale: Runpod's Pod pricing docs offer 3-month and 6-month upfront commitments for significant compute discounts, and the pricing page directs buyers to enterprise sales for reserved capacity and contract pricing. Together these cover both committed-use discounts and reserved sustained GPU capacity. missing for 10: published discount rates or terms, documented self-serve workflow for reserving capacity (reservations appear sales-gated), independent or hands-on corroboration that commitments guarantee capacity availability.
